faqs.q: What are oval and elliptical fin tubes and what are they used for?
faqs.a: Oval and Elliptical Fin Tubes are oval base tubes fitted with rectangular steel plate fins or spiral fins, usually hot-dip galvanised after finning, made to API 661 / ISO 13706 and ASTM A179. The oval shape gives a lower air-side pressure drop than round tube, for air-cooled condensers, radiators and process coolers. They are supplied from Dubai under an Indus part number for each size. See the [oval and elliptical fin tubes](/c/oval-elliptical-fin-tubes) shelf and our [guide to types of finned tubes](/blog/types-of-finned-tubes).

faqs.q: What sizes do the oval and elliptical fin tubes come in?
faqs.a: The size table lists 3 oval fin tube sizes: R1 and R2 on a 36 × 16 base tube with 26 × 55 fins, and R3 on a 36 × 12.5 base tube with 55.7 × 26 fins. R1 has a 1.5 mm wall and R2 a 2 mm wall, all with rectangular steel plate fins and a hot-dip galvanised finish. The table lists typical sizes; other sizes are made on request.

faqs.q: How do I specify oval and elliptical fin tubes?
faqs.a: Specify the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average), the length and the quantity, with the fin type, material, height, thickness and fins per inch, and the bare length at each end. For example the listed fin pitch is 3 mm on the windward row and the fin thickness 0.5 mm. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: What fin pitch and thickness do the oval fin tubes have?
faqs.a: The listed oval fin tubes have a fin pitch of 3 mm on the windward row and a fin thickness of 0.5 mm. R1 and R2 use 26 × 55 fins on a 36 × 16 base tube, and R3 uses 55.7 × 26 fins on a 36 × 12.5 base tube. Wall thickness is 1.5 mm for R1 and 2 mm for R2.

faqs.q: What do the R1, R2 and R3 part numbers for oval fin tubes mean?
faqs.a: R1, R2 and R3 are the three listed sizes of the oval fin tube, each with its own Indus part number: IH-TF-OV-OVL-R1, IH-TF-OV-OVL-R2 and IH-TF-OV-OVL-R3. R1 and R2 differ in wall, 1.5 mm and 2 mm, and R3 has a smaller 36 × 12.5 base tube. Quote the part number, or send the standard, grade and fin geometry.

faqs.q: Can elliptical fin tubes be used under API 661?
faqs.a: Under API 661, elliptical tubes shall not be used without purchaser approval (API 661 7.1.11.13, 6th ed), so get that approval before specifying them on an API 661 air cooler. The oval fin tubes are listed to API 661 / ISO 13706 and ASTM A179. Equivalent grades across ASTM, EN, DIN, JIS and GB/T standards are indicative, and we check them against each tender.

faqs.q: What are the oval fin tubes made of and how are they finished?
faqs.a: The oval fin tubes use an ASTM A179 base tube with rectangular steel plate fins (or spiral fins), and are usually hot-dip galvanised after finning. The listed finish is hot-dip galvanised. Tell us the fin material and the environment if you need a different finish.

faqs.q: What certificates come with oval and elliptical fin tubes?
faqs.a: A mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 is available on request for oval and elliptical fin tubes, and third-party inspection can be arranged against your inspection and test plan. The listing names API 661 / ISO 13706 and ASTM A179 as the standards. State the inspection you need on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Why choose oval fin tubes instead of round fin tubes?
faqs.a: Oval base tubes give a lower air-side pressure drop than round tube, which can save fan power on air-cooled condensers and radiators. Under API 661 elliptical tubes need purchaser approval. Round finned tube alternatives are on the finned tube shelves. See our [H-fin rectangular fin tubes](/c/h-fin-rectangular-fin-tubes) and [longitudinal fin tubes](/c/longitudinal-fin-tubes).

faqs.q: How should oval fin tubes be cleaned and cared for?
faqs.a: Oval fin tubes foul on the air side, so clean them on a schedule, because dirt between the fins raises air pressure drop. Our guide explains how fouling builds up and how to clean finned tube. Galvanising protects the fins and base tube from corrosion after finning. See our [guide to finned tube fouling and cleaning](/blog/finned-tube-fouling-cleaning).

faqs.q: Where are oval and elliptical fin tubes used?
faqs.a: Oval and elliptical fin tubes are used in air-cooled steam condensers and dry coolers, as an indicative application. They also suit radiators and process coolers where a low air-side pressure drop matters. Other finned tube types are on the finned tube shelves. See our [wound fin tubes](/c/wound-fin-tubes-l-ll-kl).

faqs.q: Does Indus stock oval and elliptical fin tubes in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. Indus keeps the Oval and Elliptical Fin Tubes in stock in Dubai, UAE, and ships worldwide with the best lead times. For pricing, send your part numbers and quantities via [the contact page](/contact).
